# RC41 — Delete current line or selected lines

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/wscrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- Added `Esc D` / `core.delete-line` / `Delete Line/Selection`.
- With no selection, the command deletes the current logical line and moves the cursor to the start of the removed line's former position.
- With a selection, the command deletes the full affected logical-line range.
- Whole-buffer selected deletion leaves an empty buffer with the cursor at zero.
- The operation is one dirty undoable edit, clears the selection, does not change the copy register, and read-only IDE views refuse it.
- Compact help, action footer, command palette, keymap reference, README, and iPad QA now expose the route.
